column1: # Phase 1 rate exceptions (decision 0134): visibly-off Excel cells whose only open question is
# desktop Excel evidence, so decision 0039 assigns them to M14 and they never block the Phase 1
# exit. Each is left out of the Phase 1 rate (report.json `v15_checkpoint`) of the function it
# counts toward. One cell per line, tab-separated: case!Sheet!A1 (as eval/baseline names it), the
# decision that names the cell as M14-only (four digits), and the open M14 task that owns it. A
# line hides no cell from eval/baseline or the gate: the cell stays a known failure. Add a line
# only in the PR that takes the decision naming it (decision 0044 protects eval/milestones/).
# Excel 15 cached #VALUE! where Microsoft 365 (excel-graph) gives another value; an Excel build
# below 16 does not outrank the web (decision 0030 rule 2). J136 AND("1",1) is T-1075 item 7
# (coercion.md "AND/OR/XOR text arguments"); G936, H936 and K936 MODE are T-1075 item 10
